caption:
Most golfers swing with their arms and wonder where the speed went. 🏌️

The med ball rotational throw trains the order speed comes from: load the rear hip, let the hips fire, then the ribs, then the arms.

✅ 3 x 5 each side
✅ Load the rear hip first
❌ Don't fling with your arms or fall off balance at the finish

Send this to the friend who out-drives you.
